messages:
Elena (Finance): FYI 10:03 CET 1h ago
Customer: VitaEuropa on Private deployment raised a ticket: their renewal invoice RNL-2027-04 shows platform fee in USD while they expected EUR and VAT handling looks off. They were quoted EUR amounts in the SOW.

Martin (AM): They signed SOW with prices in EUR and gave local VAT ID. We should not have converted to USD at renewal. Can you paste invoice lines?

Noemi (Billing Ops): Invoice extract from billing system: ```
Invoice: RNL-2027-04
Customer: VitaEuropa GmbH
Period: 2027-04-01 - 2028-03-31
Currency: USD
Lines:
- DEDICATED_POOL_ANNUAL    Reserved GPU pool (annual)    $300,000
- PLATFORM_SUBSCRIPTION_ANNUAL  Platform subscription (annual)  $45,000
- SUPPORT_PREMIUM_ANNUAL   Support - premium (annual)   $18,000
- VAT                      VAT (0%?)                     $0
Total: $363,000
```

Noemi (Billing Ops): System shows USD because the customer account default currency is USD (legacy from trial), even though SOW explicitly listed EUR. Also VAT line shows 0% because VAT calc fell back to reseller logic that assumes non-EU or missing VAT ID.

Elena (Finance): Customer says this breaks their procurement (must be EUR invoice with 0% VAT reverse charge citing their VAT ID). They want corrected invoice in EUR and proper reverse-charge VAT text. They also noted the USD invoice introduced an FX delta vs the EUR quote.

Priya (Tax): Quick tax check: If VitaEuropa provided valid EU VAT ID, we should issue an invoice in EUR with 0% VAT and the clause "Reverse charge applies per EU VAT rules; VAT ID: DE999999999". We must also ensure the ledger records the contract currency as EUR for exchange-rate reporting, else RevRec will be off.

Ola (Legal): Contract SOW explicitly lists pricing in EUR and references local VAT treatment in section 7.1. Legal ok with reissuing. Suggest we include statement: "Reissued invoice to align with SOW currency and VAT handling; original invoice VOIDED."

Noemi (Billing Ops): Proposed ops steps: 1) Void RNL-2027-04 and reissue RNL-2027-04A in EUR using SOW pricing (Platform €41,000, Support €16,400, Dedicated pool €273,000) and include reverse-charge VAT line 0% with VAT ID noted; 2) Record FX adjustment memo INTCORR-522 to capture realized FX gain/loss between USD draft and EUR reissue; 3) Patch BF-2350 to prefer contract SOW currency over account default for renewal runs. ETA: 1 business day pending approvals.

Martin (AM): Please cc me on the customer message. Sales will apologize for the procurement disruption; they expect a corrected invoice in EUR with reverse-charge wording.

Elena (Finance): Approve reissue and FX memo. Priya, can you confirm exact VAT clause text we should use?

Priya (Tax): Recommended text: "Reverse charge: VAT to be accounted for by the recipient under Article 196 of Council Directive 2006/112/EC. VAT ID: DE999999999. No VAT charged by Redwood Inference." Use this exact phrasing.

Ola (Legal): Approve the phrasing. Add: "No admission of liability; reissue corrects invoice format to align with SOW."

billing-bot: Created ticket TKT-9412 linking RNL-2027-04. Branch billing/fix/prefer-sow-currency-2350 created. Credit memo CM-2027-118 prepared (void + reissue flow).

Noemi (Billing Ops): Reissue complete: RNL-2027-04A in EUR created, amounts match SOW, reverse-charge text included. Internal memo INTCORR-522 logged for FX reconciliation. Sent to customer and CC'd Sales.

Elena (Finance): Confirmed received copy. RevRec please note currency change for recognition schedule.

Martin (AM): Customer responded: "Thanks, invoice looks correct now" :white_check_mark:. Appreciated fast turnaround.

Priya (Tax): Thanks 1 confirm VAT closure. I'll close my ticket after verifying EU VAT ID in VIES.

Elena (Finance): Closing loop: Billing patch BF-2350 prioritized to avoid recurrence. Will monitor similar accounts with mismatched account currency vs SOW currency.

Martin (AM): Thanks everyone :clap:
